name: System Friction Institute
primary_definition: System Friction Institute makes visible the friction that systems learn to normalize.
operational_definition: An evidence-governed instrument for observing a signal inside a changing field, proposing a minimal intervention and learning from the documented difference between prediction and outcome.
canonical_question: What structural configuration of a signal, under what world state and field conditions, produces particular patterns of propagation, persistence, transformation or disappearance?

instruments.name: Modelo Integral Homeostático Multi-nodo
instruments.purpose: Represent structural variables, capacity, friction and homeostatic conditions with explicit evidence and missing-data handling.

instruments.name: DIOL-SF
instruments.purpose: Reconstruct longitudinal trajectories while separating real, observed, reconstructed and projected states.

instruments.name: Método SFI de Inferencia
instruments.purpose: Generate and preserve primary and rival hypotheses until discriminating evidence separates them.

instruments.name: Método de Observación y Perturbación Humana
instruments.purpose: Observe human systems and design proportional, minimal perturbations with explicit return and contrast.

instruments.name: MOP-S
instruments.purpose: Study persistence, transformation or disappearance of signals across carriers, platforms and time.

instruments.name: FAD
instruments.purpose: Specialized structural analysis of sound/music objects where applicable.

instruments.name: World Spectrum Observation
instruments.purpose: Persist world-state snapshots, source health, confidence and longitudinal observations across ten dimensions.

instruments.name: World Vector
instruments.purpose: Represent current domain values, tensions, dominant signals and observed context.

instruments.name: Atlas / SFI Reference Bank
instruments.purpose: Normalize cases and link configuration, evidence, prediction-at-T0, perturbation, return, outcome and model versions.

object_analysis_contract.preserve_evidence_exception: Original objects are preserved only through a separate governed evidence workflow when reproducibility or audit requires it.

interpretation_limits: A provisional prediction is not historically validated.
Agents execute method roles but are not epistemic authority.
Declared targets are distinct from inferred attractors; declared exclusions are distinct from inferred ejectors/repelling regions.
Do not infer undisclosed psychological states, motives or diagnoses.

analytics.consent_mode: v2; denied by default until user choice
analytics.allowed_scope: Page navigation and non-PII instrument-use events
